q: The EEG of childhood absence epilepsy shows:
e: Absence epilepsy shows 3 Hz spike-and-wave discharges.

q: Infantile spasms with ash-leaf spots: what is the treatment of choice?
e: Vigabatrin is the drug of choice in tuberous sclerosis.

q: Which drug may worsen absence seizures?
e: Carbamazepine can make absence seizures worse.

q: Gum hypertrophy is a side effect of:
e: Gum hypertrophy is a side effect of phenytoin.
